scene_context.location: Karaikudi, Chettinad region, Sivaganga district, Tamil Nadu, India
scene_context.moment: A quiet early morning kolam-making ritual in a traditional Chettinad home

image_prompt.subject: A young Tamil woman drawing an intricate traditional white rice-flour kolam at the entrance of her family home
image_prompt.setting: A Chettinad heritage mansion courtyard in Karaikudi, with carved teak pillars, a traditional tiled roof, Athangudi floor tiles and a wooden main doorway
image_prompt.time_of_day: Early morning, approximately 6:00 AM, during Margazhi
image_prompt.lighting: Soft golden sunrise light with gentle natural shadows and a faint cool morning atmosphere

camera.angle: Eye level, slightly diagonal view across the courtyard
camera.depth_of_field: Natural moderate depth of field; architecture and kolam remain recognisable

image_prompt.style: Photorealistic documentary photography, culturally grounded, natural and understated
cultural_details: Chettinad architectural proportions and carved teak details
Athangudi patterned tiles used appropriately as flooring
Traditional Kandangi cotton saree in a restrained Chettinad colour combination
Fresh jasmine flowers worn in the woman's hair
Kolam drawn with rice flour, with believable hand-drawn symmetry
A brass kuthu vilakku placed naturally near the entrance
avoid: Generic North Indian or Rajasthani architecture
Thanjavur temple architecture in place of a Chettinad mansion
Generic synthetic bridal sari or inaccurate Kanchipuram silk
Oversized or physically impossible kolam patterns
Modern buildings, cars or plastic decorations
Extra fingers, distorted hands or malformed faces

workflow: Generate image_1 using image_prompt without overrides.
Generate image_2 using the same image_prompt and apply only the image_2 overrides.

Generate the short video using image_prompt as the base and add video_prompt.motion and video_prompt.continuity.
generation_notes.consistency_rule: For each image variation, keep every field unchanged unless it is explicitly listed in change_only and overrides.
generation_notes.tool_note: If the image or video tool accepts structured JSON, provide the relevant object. If it accepts only text, paste the JSON object or convert its fields into a prompt.
